plain: Having to do with the lawmaking body called Congress.

webster.text: Pertaining to a congress, or to the congress of the United States; as congressional debates.

example.quote: It is, therefore, we very universally see, in this kind of government, the congressional powers placed in a few hands, and accordingly limited, and specifically enumerated: and the local assemblies strong and well guarded, and composed of numerous members.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XVII, Jan. 23, 1788
